serverInfo.title: Crawler IP Verifier
serverInfo.description: Tell real Googlebot/GPTBot from fake: 500 IPs a call, firewall allowlist out. Free, no key. Bulk address verification against mirrored operator prefix lists, prefix arithmetic, and paste-ready allowlists. Call verify_my_address first: no arguments at all, and it checks the address you are calling from against every mirrored operator prefix. whoami and example are the other two zero-argument calls.
